mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hx_movies (title, rating, duration, genre, director, actors, release_date, poster_url, description, status, tmdb_id, gmt_create) VALUES (#{title}, #{rating}, #{duration}, #{genre}, #{director}, #{actors}, #{releaseDate}, #{posterUrl}, #{description}, #{status}, #{tmdbId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE hx_movies SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
